evidence.why: setIcon is a public method on the exported Submenu class of the published @tauri-apps/api npm package; a repo-wide grep for 'setIcon' finds only unrelated sibling setIcon methods on Window/IconMenuItem/TrayIcon and this definition, with zero in-repo callers in examples, tests, or the Rust plugin code, so it is only ever invoked by external consumer applications outside this repo.
